title: Emergency Phrases: English <-> Arabic
summary: Essential English-Arabic bilingual communication card to point at or read during an emergency.
content:
Show this card on screen and point directly to the text if you cannot understand each other verbally.

1. EN: Help! Please help me. | AR: !ساعدوني! الرجاء مساعدتي (Saa'idooni! Ar-rajaa' musaa'adati)
2. EN: I need an ambulance and the police. | AR: أحتاج إلى سيارة إسعاف والشرطة (Ahtaaju ilaa sayyarat is'aaf wash-shurtah)
3. EN: I am hurt / injured. | AR: أنا مصاب [male] / أنا مصابة [female] (Ana musaab / Ana musaabah)
4. EN: I have a medical condition (diabetes / heart condition). | AR: لدي حالة طبية (مرض السكري / مشكلة في القلب) (Ladayya haalah tibbiyyah: marad as-sukkari / mushkilah fil-qalb)
5. EN: Where is the nearest hospital? | AR: أين أقرب مستشفى؟ (Ayna aqrab mustashfa?)
6. EN: I need clean drinking water and food. | AR: أحتاج إلى ماء صالح للشرب وطعام (Ahtaaju ilaa maa' saalih lish-shurb wa ta'aam)
7. EN: The power and electricity are out. | AR: انقطعت الكهرباء (Inqata'at al-kahrabaa')
8. EN: Is this water safe to drink? | AR: هل هذا الماء صالح للشرب؟ (Hal hatha al-maa' saalih lish-shurb?)
9. EN: I need my medication immediately. | AR: أحتاج إلى دوائي فوراً (Ahtaaju ilaa dawaa'ee fawran)
10. EN: Do you speak English or Arabic? | AR: هل تتحدث الإنجليزية أو العربية؟ (Hal tatahaddath al-ingleeziyyah aw al-arabiyyah?)

Tip for responders and residents: Speak slowly and clearly. Point to specific phrases, use deliberate hand gestures, point to painful areas or empty medication boxes, and write critical numbers or names clearly on paper.
